description.zh:
是否允许蜜罐访问外网。取值：
- **true**：允许
- **false**：不允许
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow the honeypot to access the Internet. Valid values:
- **true**: Allowed.
- **false**: Not allowed.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh:
指定要升级的管理节点ID。
>调用[ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the management node to upgrade.
>You can call the [ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

title.zh: 升级蜜罐管理节点版本

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas upgrade-honeypot-node --allow-honeypot-access-internet true --node-id a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpgradeHoneypotNode --region cn-hangzhou --AllowHoneypotAccessInternet true --NodeId 'a882e590-b87b-45a6-87b9-d0a3e5a00000' --Lang zh
